question: How many members are nominated in the Rajya Sabha by the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The President of India can nominate up to **12 members** to the Rajya Sabha.
 
• These nominations are made under **Article 80** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The nominated members are chosen for their expertise in fields such as literature, science, art, and social service.
 
• This provision ensures that the Rajya Sabha has representation from distinguished individuals who have made significant contributions to society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 80 of the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• This article deals with the composition of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• It specifies the maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha as 250 members.
 
• Out of these, 238 members are representatives of the States and Union Territories, and 12 are nominated by the President.
 
 
 
• **Role of Rajya Sabha:**
 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the Upper House of the Parliament of India.
 
• It represents the States and Union Territories of India.
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha review, amend, and pass legislation.
 
• It acts as a permanent house and is not subject to dissolution.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility for Nomination:**
 
 
• Nominated members are chosen for their expertise and contributions to society.
 
• They are not required to have any political affiliation.
 
• This ensures a non-partisan representation of eminent personalities in the Rajya Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Notable Nominated Members:**
 
 
• Some notable nominated members include Lata Mangeshkar (singer), Sachin Tendulkar (cricketer), and Raghuram Rajan (economist).
 
• These members have brought their expertise and perspective to legislative discussions.
